note: Presentation model: how canonical topics are grouped for navigation. This is NOT the domain model -- categories and topics are referenced by key/name and MUST exist in taxonomy.json, which stays the single source of truth for the vocabulary. Counts are NOT stored here; the backend computes them over loaded CivicContent at request time (resource.subcategory == topic OR content.tags contains topic). A category absent from this file has no topic groups and renders a flat topic list. Only categories with many topics are grouped -- a group header over a single topic is noise. A future AI-assisted generator replaces THIS FILE ONLY (flipping 'source' to 'ai-generated'); taxonomy.json, the backend and the frontend are unaffected.
